newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares to remain firm, small caps lead.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares to remain firm, small caps lead.

text.p: Singapore shares are expected to retain their firm tone on Friday with small capitalised stocks leading the way.
Dealers said they expected Thursday's strong gains to spill over to this morning though some profit taking is also expected.
"Wall Street has been behaving. So there should be some more room to go though," said a broker with a Singapore firm.
The Straits Times Industrials Index closed 6.59 points higher at 1,981.28 on Thursday.
